Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

As a (Senior) Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.

Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

A successful (Senior) Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. To support its continued growth and customer-centric strategy, the company is looking for a Customer Experience Representative to strengthen its EMEA Sales & Operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Experience Representative, you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of B2B customers and play a key role in delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance teams, you will ensure smooth order processing while proactively supporting commercial activities and continuous improvement initiatives.Customer Relationship Management

• Manage and follow up a dedicated portfolio of customers across the EMEA region.
• Act as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and service-related matters.
• Build strong customer relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Handle customer claims, returns and complaints professionally and efficiently.
• Gather relevant customer and market feedback and share insights internally.

Order Management & Sales Support

• Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
• Follow up on orders, backorders and delivery schedules.
• Prepare and follow up quotations in collaboration with the Account Managers.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding pricing, lead times and product availability.
• Support the sales pipeline and contribute to achieving business targets.
• Monitor service performance and customer agreements.

Process Improvement & Operations

• Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with logistics and operations teams to optimize transport, packaging and order flows.
• Contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.

Financial Follow-up

• Support the monitoring of outstanding customer payments.
• Collaborate with finance teams regarding credit limits, payment conditions and invoice-related matters.

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or Inside Sales.
• Experience within an international B2B environment is a strong plus.
• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP is an advantage).
• Fluent Dutch and English
• Proactive and able to work autonomously.

Our client is a leading international logistics group operating within the temperature-controlled supply chain sector. Active across multiple European markets, the company combines operational excellence, strong financial backing, automation, and ambitious growth plans. The environment is dynamic, entrepreneurial, performance-driven, and focused on continuous improvement and innovation

Jobomschrijving

• Define and execute the facilities, maintenance, and engineering strategy across key operational sites.
• Ensure maximum equipment availability, reliability, and operational continuity.
• Lead preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for automated infrastructure and technical assets.
• Manage engineering teams, external contractors, and specialised service providers.
• Develop and monitor maintenance KPIs, budgets, and performance standards.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
• Oversee major capital expenditure projects, site upgrades, and infrastructure investments.
• Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory, and quality requirements.
• Support automation initiatives and technological enhancements across operations.
• Collaborate closely with operations, finance, procurement, and executive leadership teams.

• Degree in Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, Electromechanics, Facilities Management, or related discipline.
• Extensive leadership experience within logistics, manufacturing, industrial, automated warehousing, cold chain, or similar asset-intensive environments.
• Strong expertise in maintenance management, engineering operations, and technical infrastructure.
• Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and major investment projects.
• Proven capability to manage budgets, suppliers, and performance improvement programmes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication capabilities.
• Fluent English required; additional European languages are considered an advantage.
• Comfortable operating within a fast-growing, international organisation.

• International Automotive Company with office Brussels and Antwerp
• French Speaking environment
Client Details

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.
Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.

What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Projects Lead - Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About Us
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The Role
As Business Operations Associate your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs. 

You will often get a question with little more than a goal attached. We trust you to figure out the rest: to structure the problem yourself and to deliver work of a high standard.
 

What You'll Do
Your main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:
 
 

• Take full ownership of company-wide projects, from scoping and planning to execution and follow-up. 

• Conduct market research and analyses, for example on new markets, crops, competitors or customer 

• segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 

• Set up and follow up on our company OKRs together with management and team leads. 

• Handle confidential information, such as financial, strategic and personnel matters, with discretion.  

As Zymofix grows, new projects will land on your desk.

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in Bioscience Engineering (bio-ingenieur). 

• You are mature and discreet, and you know how to handle confidential information. 

• You set a high standard for the work you deliver: well thought out, structured and well presented. 

• You need few instructions to deliver a strong result. You structure a problem yourself, ask the right questions and take it from there. 

• You enjoy project work and are comfortable juggling several projects at once. 

• You have strong analytical skills and can turn research and data into clear, actionable conclusions. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• A first work experience, for example in consulting or a startup environment, is a plus.
